description: Observatoire des ondes - Relais 2G-3G-4G-5G - Tours Métropole Val de Loire is a dataset listed in opendataTMVL open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by ANFR. Observatoire du déploiement des réseaux mobiles publié par l'Agence Nationale des Fréquences (ANFR). Etat des lieux du déploiement des antennes relais 2G, 3G, 4G et 5G réalisé par l’ANFR. Coverage: Tours Métropole Val de Loire. The portal files it under Aménagement Numérique du Territoire. Its keywords are Télécom, Mobile, 4G, Réseau, Commune, EPCI. The portal shows 2,589 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-07-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons-CC0 (http://opendefinition.org/od/1.1/fr/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-tours-metropole-fr-portal.
